section: Kentucky corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Limited liability entity tax (LLET) minimum
note: Applies to corporations, LLCs, S corporations and limited partnerships; businesses with total gross receipts or gross profits of $3 million or less pay only this minimum.
source_title: Kentucky Department of Revenue: Corporation Income and Limited Liability Entity Tax

section: Kentucky corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Limited liability entity tax (LLET) rates
value: Lesser of 0.095% of Kentucky gross receipts or 0.75% of Kentucky gross profits (above $6 million; sliding scale from $3 million to $6 million)
note: LLET paid above the $175 minimum is credited against Kentucky corporate income tax.
source_title: Kentucky Department of Revenue: Corporation Income and Limited Liability Entity Tax

label: Levied by
value: County fiscal courts, school boards and other local taxing districts (library, fire, extension, soil conservation, etc.), plus a state rate
note: Local rate increases above 4% in revenue (House Bill 44 rules) require a public hearing and can be put to a recall vote.
source_title: Kentucky Department of Revenue: Property Tax Rates

label: State oversight
value: Kentucky Department of Revenue, Office of Property Valuation
note: County property valuation administrators (PVAs) assess property under the Department's supervision (KRS 132.420).
source_title: Kentucky Legislature: KRS 132.420 Duties and powers of property valuation administrator

label: State real property tax rate (2026)
note: Set each year by July 1 under KRS 132.020 and cut whenever assessments grow more than 4% (10.6 cents in 2025).
